about:
Prysmian Group USA is headquartered in Houston, Texas. The U.S. entity was established in 2005 as part of the global Prysmian Group, which traces its roots back 150 years. The company operates manufacturing facilities in Texas and other states.

The company produces power cables, data cables, and telecommunication cables for electrical utilities, telecom, and industrial applications. Its U.S. operations employ over 15,000 people across multiple facilities. The product portfolio includes low-carbon aluminum cables designed to reduce the carbon footprint of AI infrastructure and hollow-core fiber for AI-ready data centers.

Prysmian serves utilities, oil and gas, telecommunications, and data center industries. Its customers include electrical utilities, telecom operators, and industrial firms. The company has recently expanded its submarine telecom capabilities through the acquisition of Xtera and deepened its strategic partnership with Aurubis.

Prysmian emphasizes local production in the United States, with leadership stating that the U.S. values local production. The company differentiates itself through low-carbon cable innovations and a global footprint spanning over 50 countries.
